title: What's New: E-Documents and Clearance Model (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Business value of clearance model and e-documents
Clearance model process and future features
E-document service and workflow demo setup

features.name: Clearance model for e-documents
features.description: A new framework enabling pre-approval of invoices by tax authorities or third-party partners before sending to customers. Supports three, four, or five corner models with a foundational process involving send, receiver, and government authorities.
caveats: Framework only, not localized by default
Clearance service implementation required per localization

features.name: E-document workflow orchestration
features.description: Workflow-based framework to orchestrate communication between clearance service and provider service. Workflow templates guide users through setup with five defined steps from document creation to customer email delivery.
caveats: Requires manual workflow setup for each localization
Service endpoints must be configured per implementation

features.name: Clearance service and provider service setup
features.description: Two separate e-document services must be configured: one for clearance submission to authorities and one for sending to customers. Services are country-specific and may need custom implementation.
caveats: Clearance service does not exist in Business Central and must be built

features.name: Access point support (sender and receiver)
features.description: Framework supports both sender access point and receiver access point models for document transmission to government authorities and customers.
caveats: Access point selection depends on country requirements

features.name: QR code support in e-documents
features.description: Clearance response from authorities can include QR codes which are embedded in invoices and included in customer email attachments.
caveats: QR code inclusion depends on localization requirements

features.name: Receiver validation (future)
features.description: Feature to validate documents against government office requirements when receiving invoices. Currently not supported but planned for future delivery.

features.name: E-documents localization framework
features.description: Framework supporting localization for multiple countries including VeriFacTur in Spain, CFDI in Mexico, and India invoicing. Enables partner-based localization on top of the e-documents clearance model.
caveats: Framework only, no default localization included
Each country localization must be built separately
Microsoft will migrate existing India and Mexico e-invoicing to new format

features.name: Migration of existing e-invoicing formats
features.description: Microsoft plans to migrate existing India and Mexico electronic invoicing from old model to new e-documents format with clearance model. VeriFacTur 2 for Spain also planned.
